# Plan: Pixel-Perfect Navbar & Footer Audit and Fix

## Source of Truth
- Webflow HTML: `boldteq-v1-0.webflow/index.html`
- Webflow CSS: `boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css`
- Next.js files:
  - `src/components/layout/navbar.tsx`
  - `src/components/layout/mobile-nav.tsx`
  - `src/components/layout/footer.tsx`

---

## NAVBAR DISCREPANCIES

### 1. Banner strip: `.banner-section` + `.banner-content`

**Webflow CSS:**
```
.banner-section { padding: 10px 5%; }   ← NOT py-2.5 (10px top/bottom, 5% sides)
.banner-content { gap: 12px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; display: flex; }
.paragraph-regular.capitalize { font-size: 14px; line-height: 24px; color: #fff; text-transform: capitalize; }
.beta-link { color: #fff; font-family: Roobert PRO, Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; }
```

**Current Next.js:**
- `py-2.5` → should be `py-[10px]` (py-2.5 = 10px, this is actually fine)
- `gap-3` (12px) → should be `gap-3` = correct
- Missing `px-[5%]` on banner outer — currently has `px-[5%]` via inner div max-width → fine structurally but the outer wrapper needs padding like `padding: 10px 5%`, not just py + inner max-width
- Banner padding: Webflow uses `padding: 10px 5%` on the section itself. Current code puts `py-2.5` on outer div then `px-[5%]` on inner. This is functionally equivalent but structurally different. No visual difference.
- `beta-link` is `text-decoration: underline` in Webflow. Current code has `underline` class. CORRECT.
- 479px breakpoint: `.banner-content` becomes `flex-flow: column; gap: 5px`. Current code doesn't handle this. **FIX NEEDED for mobile.**

### 2. Navbar: `.navbar`

**Webflow CSS:**
```
.navbar { z-index: 999999; background-color: #fff; width: 100%; padding: 6px 1%; position: relative; }
```
At 479px: `padding: 10px 5%; position: static;`

**Current Next.js:**
- `padding: 6px 1%` → current is `px-[1%] py-1.5` (py-1.5 = 6px). CORRECT.
- `position: relative` → current is `sticky top-0` on the header wrapper. Webflow navbar is `position: relative` but the whole `header-sec` is the sticky element. The header wrapper `sticky top-0 z-[999999]` is correct approach.
- At 479px, navbar uses `padding: 10px 5%`. Current mobile doesn't change padding. **FIX NEEDED.**

### 3. Nav container: `.nav-23-container`

**Webflow CSS:**
```
.nav-23-container { gap: 10px; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; max-width: none; display: flex; }
```
At 479px: `flex-flow: row;`

**Current Next.js:**
- `gap-2.5` (10px) on inner div. CORRECT.
- `justify-between`. CORRECT.
- `w-full`. CORRECT.

### 4. Logo: `.nav-23-logo` + `.logo`

**Webflow CSS:**
```
.nav-23-logo { width: 130px; height: 100%; padding-left: 0; padding-right: 0; }
.logo { object-fit: contain; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
At 479px: .nav-23-logo { width: 160px; height: auto; }
```

**Current Next.js:**
- `w-[130px]` on the Link. CORRECT for desktop.
- At 479px logo should become 160px wide. **FIX NEEDED** — no responsive logo width.

### 5. Nav links: `.nav-23-link` + `.menu-text`

**Webflow CSS:**
```
.nav-23-link { color: #000; background-color: transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 5px; font-size: 16px (via menu-text); font-weight: 500 (via menu-text); }
.nav-23-link:hover { color: #000; background-color: transparent; }
.menu-text { color: #082753; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; font-family: Roobert PRO; }
```

**Current Next.js:**
- `text-[14px]` → should be **`text-[16px]`**. **BIG FIX NEEDED.**
- `px-1.5` = 6px → should be `px-[5px] py-2`. Currently `px-1.5 py-2`. px-1.5 = 6px vs 5px — minor but should match exactly.
- `text-black` → should be `text-[#082753]`. **FIX NEEDED.**
- `hover:bg-transparent` → Webflow has `hover:bg-transparent` too. CORRECT.

### 6. Nav dropdown toggle: `.nav-23-dropdown-toggle`

**Webflow CSS:**
```
.nav-23-dropdown-toggle {
  gap: 4px; color: #000; background-color: transparent;
  border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 10px;
  font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; 
  transition: background-color .3s, color .3s;
  display: flex; justify-content: flex-start; align-items: center;
}
.nav-23-dropdown-toggle:hover { color: #000; background-color: transparent; }
.nav-23-dropdown-toggle.w--open { background-color: #f5f7f8; }
```

**Current Next.js (NavDropdown button):**
- `gap-0.5` (2px) → should be `gap-1` (4px). **FIX NEEDED.**
- `text-[14px]` → should be `text-[16px]`. **FIX NEEDED.**
- `px-1.5 py-2` → should be `px-[10px] py-2 pr-2` (8px 8px 8px 10px). **FIX NEEDED.**
- `text-black` → should be `text-[#082753]`. **FIX NEEDED.**
- Missing `line-height: 1.5`. **FIX NEEDED.**

### 7. Nav dropdown arrow: `.nav-23-dropdown-arrow`

**Webflow CSS:**
```
.nav-23-dropdown-arrow { color: #082753; width: 24px; height: 24px; padding: 6px 2px 2px; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; }
```

Note: the arrow in the Solutions dropdown uses `.nav-dropdown-arrow` (different class):
```
.nav-dropdown-arrow { width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: 2px; display: flex; }
```

**Current Next.js:**
- The ChevronDownIcon wrapper is `flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center text-[#082753]`. Width 24px, height 24px. CORRECT for `.nav-23-dropdown-arrow`.
- But missing the specific padding `6px 2px 2px`. **FIX NEEDED** — minor but should match.

### 8. Schedule Demo button: `.btn-primary`

**Webflow CSS:**
```
.btn-primary {
  color: #fff; background-color: #111827;
  background-image: url('../images/Group-46729-2.svg'), linear-gradient(90deg, #21cfff, #019ae6);
  background-position: 93%, 0 0; background-repeat: no-repeat, repeat; background-size: auto, auto;
  border: 2px transparent; border-radius: .75rem;
  padding: 8px 3rem 8px 1rem;
  font-family: Roobert PRO, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.75rem;
  display: inline-flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center;
}
.btn-primary:hover { background-color: #092245; background-image: url('../images/Group-46729-2.svg'); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; }
At 991px: font-size: 16px;
At 767px: font-size: .8rem; (in group with other selectors)
At 479px: flex-direction: column; width: 100%; padding-left: .5rem; font-size: .9rem;
```

**Current Next.js:**
- `px-[3rem] py-2 pr-[1rem]` → BUT Webflow is `padding: 8px 3rem 8px 1rem` (top:8px, right:3rem, bottom:8px, left:1rem). Current: `px-[3rem]` sets left AND right to 3rem, then `pr-[1rem]` overrides right to 1rem. That's `padding: 8px 1rem 8px 3rem` — **LEFT AND RIGHT ARE SWAPPED!** **CRITICAL FIX NEEDED.**
  - Correct: `pl-[1rem] pr-[3rem] py-2` 
- Has custom `<ArrowRightIcon>` appended → but in Webflow it's a background-image SVG. The arrow is via `background-image`. Current approach adds an inline SVG icon which is visible but the background-image arrow at 93% is also what Webflow uses. Current implementation should remove the `<ArrowRightIcon />` component and rely on background-image only (or keep it but it double-counts). **FIX NEEDED.**
- `leading-7` vs `line-height: 1.75rem` — these are the same (1.75rem = 28px = leading-7). CORRECT.

### 9. Login button: `.button-secondary-large`

**Webflow CSS:**
```
.button-secondary-large {
  gap: 6px; color: #082753; background-color: transparent;
  border: 1px solid #082753; border-radius: 10px;
  height: auto; padding: 8px 20px;
  font-family: Roobert PRO, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5;
  display: inline-flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center;
}
.button-secondary-large:hover { color: #fff; background-color: #082753; }
At 991px: font-size: 16px;
At 479px: padding-top: 10px; padding-bottom: 10px; font-size: 14px;
```

**Current Next.js:**
- `px-5 py-2` = `padding: 8px 20px`. CORRECT.
- `border border-[#082753]` = 1px border. But should be just `border` (1px). CORRECT.
- `rounded-[10px]`. CORRECT.
- `text-[13px] font-bold`. CORRECT.
- `transition-colors duration-300`. CORRECT.

### 10. Hamburger button: `.nav-23-menu-button` + `.nav-23-menu-burger`

**Webflow CSS:**
```
.nav-23-menu-button { color: #fff; background-color: #000; border-radius: 10px; flex: none; width: 48px; height: 48px; padding: 0; }
.nav-23-menu-button.w--open { background-color: #000; }
At 991px: background-color: var(--blue); (i.e. #21cfff)
At 479px: background-color: rgba(33,207,255,0.12); width: 40px; height: 40px;
.nav-23-menu-burger { gap: 4px; flex-flow: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: flex; }
.nav-23-menu-line { transform-origin: center; background-color: currentColor; border-radius: 4px; width: 20px; height: 2px; }
At 479px: .nav-23-menu-line color: #082753 (currentColor so the button text-color changes)
At 479px: .nav-23-menu-burger { border: 1px solid #21cfff; border-radius: 8px; width: 40px; height: 40px; }
```

**Current Next.js:**
- `h-12 w-12` (48px). CORRECT for desktop.
- `rounded-[10px]`. CORRECT.
- `bg-black`. CORRECT for desktop.
- Lines: `h-0.5 w-5` (2px × 20px). CORRECT.
- Lines: `bg-white`. CORRECT (currentColor = white since button is black).

Summary of what was fixed:

**footer.tsx**
- Footer grid: added `max-[991px]:grid-cols-1` — stacks to single column at tablet
- Footer right gap: `max-[991px]:gap-[2rem]` reduces from 2.8rem at medium
- Footer heading: `max-[767px]:flex-col max-[767px]:items-start` — stacks vertically at 767px
- Links grid: split `gap-6` into `columnGap: "24px", rowGap: "56px"` (was equal 24px, now correct asymmetric)
- Links grid responsive: `max-[991px]:grid-cols-4 max-[767px]:grid-cols-2 max-[479px]:border-t-0 max-[479px]:pt-0`
- Links grid row-gap at 479px: handled via inline style (56px desktop, needs CSS override — grid stays consistent)
- Newsletter pill: `gap: "5px"`, `padding: "0 13px"` (removed vertical padding — was `py-0.5`), `lineHeight: "14px"`
- Newsletter subhead row: `gap-[10px]`, `marginBottom: "15px"` with `max-[479px]:mb-0`
- Newsletter card: kept exact desktop styles; `max-[479px]:gap-[5px]` override on card
- Newsletter title block: `max-[479px]:gap-[10px]` override
- Form block: `style={{ marginTop: "13px" }}` with `max-[479px]:mt-0 max-[479px]:pt-5 max-[479px]:pb-[10px]`
- Submit button: `max-[479px]:relative max-[479px]:right-auto max-[479px]:top-auto max-[479px]:translate-y-0 max-[479px]:w-full max-[479px]:mt-[10px]` — stacks below input at 479px
- Input: `max-[479px]:pr-3` removes the right padding offset when button is stacked
- Footer link coming-soon badge: fixed from `bg-white/10 text-white/80` to exact Webflow values (`color: #1890ff`, `backgroundColor: #e6f7ff`, `padding: 2px 4px`, `fontSize: 10px`, `lineHeight: 12px`, `fontWeight: 500`)
- Coming-soon gap: changed from `gap-2` to `gap-[10px]` matching `.coming-soon-out`
- Footer links at 479px: `max-[479px]:text-[14px] max-[479px]:leading-5`
- Social hover: replaced `hover:shadow-md` Tailwind class with exact `boxShadow: "0 2px 4px rgba(35,39,46,0.16)"` via stateful `SocialLink` component
- Legal wrapper: `gap-[9px]`, `max-[767px]:mt-10 max-[479px]:mt-5`
- Copyright outer: `max-[991px]:px-[10px] max-[991px]:py-[3px]`

**mobile-nav.tsx**
- Sheet background: `#082753` (dark navy) matching Webflow `.nav-23-menu` at 767px
- All text: white
- Nav links: white text, `borderBottom: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04)"`, `padding 12px 0`
- Dropdown toggle: white text, `justify-between`, same border-bottom
- Chevron arrow: `color: #21cfff` matching `.nav-23-dropdown-arrow` at 767px
- Header and CTA section borders: `rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`
- Login button: white border + white text adapted for dark background
- Coming soon badge: uses same exact Webflow values as navbar/footer
